reasoning_content:
Go 1.26.4 exists and is downloadable (302 to dl.google.com). Let me download and install Go. go.mod says `go 1.26.4`, so I need Go >= 1.26.4. Let me download it.

Let me install Go 1.26.4. Actually latest stable is 1.27.1; either works. But go directive with patch means minimum toolchain. Use 1.26.4 to match.

Download ~70MB.

action.command: cd /tmp && curl -sL --max-time 300 -o go.tar.gz https://dl.google.com/go/go1.26.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz && ls -la go.tar.gz && rm -rf /usr/local/go && tar -C /usr/local -xzf go.tar.gz && /usr/local/go/bin/go version && ln -sf /usr/local/go/bin/go /usr/local/bin/go && ln -sf /usr/local/go/bin/gofmt /usr/local/bin/gofmt && go version

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && curl -sL --max-time 300 -o go.tar.gz https://dl.google.com/go/go1.26.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz && ls -la go.tar.gz && rm -rf /usr/local/go && tar -C /usr/local -xzf go.tar.gz && /usr/local/go/bin/go version && ln -sf /usr/local/go/bin/go /usr/local/bin/go && ln -sf /usr/local/go/bin/gofmt /usr/local/bin/gofmt && go version", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Download and install Go 1.26.4"}
